clue.text: Foretell proportional representation law

parts.note: PR is the standard abbreviation for proportional representation, a voting system
an edict is a decree or law issued by an authority

explanation.surface: Someone predicting that a new electoral law will bring in proportional representation.
explanation.definitionFit: To foretell is to say in advance what will happen, a straight synonym.

clue.text: Something to make you feel better? A Republican's support

parts.words: Something to make you feel better
parts.note: a pill is a tablet taken to make you feel better
R is the abbreviation for Republican

explanation.surface: A US Republican's backer is something that cheers them up.
explanation.definitionFit: A pillar is a column holding up a structure, and figuratively a supporter.

clue.text: Tickle old sweetheart with sex appeal in church

parts.note: an ex is a former partner

indicators.note: in means the word for sex appeal goes inside the abbreviation for church

parts.note: CE is the Church of England
it is old slang for sex appeal

explanation.surface: A former lover teasingly flirting during a church service.
explanation.walkthrough: CE is the Church of England; IT for sex appeal is old slang, as in the It girl.
explanation.definitionFit: To tickle someone's fancy is to arouse or stimulate their interest.

clue.text: At home and fed up with current new tie that's worked loose

parts.note: in means at home

indicators.note: up in a down clue means the word fed is written upwards, reversed

parts.note: I is the physics symbol for electric current

indicators.note: worked means the letters of tie are worked into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone at home, sick of the new tie that has come undone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' reverses FED to DEF; 'worked' rearranges TIE to ITE.
explanation.definitionFit: Loose here means vague or not exact, as an indefinite arrangement is.

clue.text: Antelope caught, creating concern

parts.note: the topi is an African antelope
C is the cricket abbreviation for caught

explanation.surface: An antelope being caught causes worry.
explanation.definitionFit: A topic is a subject or matter, the sense of concern as a business or affair.

clue.text: Saw dog commonly held by lead

indicators.note: held by means the dog's name sits inside the symbol for the metal

parts.note: Pb is the chemical symbol for the metal lead
Rover is the stock name for a pet dog

explanation.surface: A common dog being held on its lead.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lead' reads as a dog's leash but is the metal, whose chemical symbol is PB.
explanation.definitionFit: A saw is an old saying or maxim, the same sense as a proverb.

clue.text: Standing by chap on hospital department

parts.note: per means by, as in per post
a man is a chap
ENT is the ear, nose and throat department

explanation.surface: A man standing beside a hospital ward.
explanation.definitionFit: A standing committee or order is a lasting, fixed one.

clue.text: Admits tucking into brown sauce

indicators.note: tucking into suggests eating but here the answer is found lodged inside the words

explanation.surface: Someone confesses to tucking into brown sauce, a British table condiment.
explanation.walkthrough: Brown sauce is a tangy British table sauce, like HP.
explanation.definitionFit: To own up, or own, is to confess or acknowledge something.

clue.text: Rebellion with no leader initially speaks volumes

indicators.note: with no leader means the first letter is cut from the word for rebellion

parts.note: sedition is incitement to rebellion

indicators.note: initially picks the opening letter of speaks

explanation.surface: A leaderless uprising says a great deal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'speaks volumes' reads as one phrase, but 'volumes' alone is the definition; the leading S of sedition reappears at the end as the first letter of 'speaks'.
explanation.definitionFit: Editions are printed versions or issues of a book, so volumes.

clue.text: Great exclamation of delight on large ride

parts.note: big means great
whee is a cry of glee
L is the clothing-size abbreviation for large

explanation.surface: Shouting with joy on a big fairground ride.
explanation.definitionFit: A Ferris wheel at a fairground is a fairground attraction, one you ride.

clue.text: Bright university student returned with detectives

indicators.note: returned means the two letters for university and student come back in reverse order

parts.note: L stands for learner, the student driver's plate
CID is the Criminal Investigation Department, the British police detectives

explanation.surface: A clever student coming back to university alongside police detectives.
explanation.walkthrough: CID is Britain's Criminal Investigation Department, the plain-clothes detectives.
explanation.definitionFit: Lucid can mean bright or clear-minded, as in a lucid moment or a shining surface.

clue.text: Breathing heavily, eating fries on a regular basis? It's what dad might be doing

indicators.note: eating means the breathing word swallows the letters chosen from the food

parts.note: panting is breathing heavily and fast

indicators.note: on a regular basis picks every second letter of fries

explanation.surface: A puffing father wolfing down fries, framed as a picture of fatherhood.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface pictures a greedy dad, but the definition is the whole closing phrase about what fathers do with children.
explanation.definitionFit: Raising children is the job of a mother or father, so a dad at home with the kids is doing it.

clue.text: Mock if CIA trial collapsed

indicators.note: a trial that collapsed fell apart, so these letters are broken up and rebuilt

explanation.surface: A spy-agency court case falls apart and is ridiculed as a sham.
explanation.definitionFit: Mock as an adjective means fake or imitation, as in mock leather.

clue.text: Molly perhaps is in fine hotel

indicators.note: in places the word is between the two letters for fine and hotel

parts.note: F is the pencil-grading abbreviation for fine
H is hotel in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A woman called Molly staying at a smart hotel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Molly' looks like a woman's name, but the molly is a small aquarium species.
explanation.definitionFit: The molly is a popular tropical aquarium species, so it is an example of the category.

clue.text: Discovered I end diet if upset

indicators.note: upset means the letters are knocked over and reordered

explanation.surface: A dieter threatening to quit their diet if found out.
explanation.definitionFit: To be discovered is to be recognised or found out, a synonym.

clue.text: Dine out with Trump's vice-president, concealing desire for lack of bias

indicators.note: out signals that the letters of dine are put out of order
concealing means the politician's surname hides the word for desire inside it

parts.note: Mike Pence was vice-president in Donald Trump's first term
an end is an aim or goal, something desired

explanation.surface: Eating out with Mike Pence while hiding one's political leanings.
explanation.walkthrough: Mike Pence was Donald Trump's first-term vice-president; 'desire' as END means an aim or goal.
explanation.definitionFit: Being free of outside control extends to judgment: impartiality, not taking sides.

clue.text: Crack soldiers in Egypt emptied kit

indicators.note: in means the joke and the soldiers sit inside the shell of Egypt
emptied means Egypt loses its middle, leaving only its outside letters

parts.note: a crack is a wisecrack, a quip
men are soldiers, the ranks

explanation.surface: Elite troops in Egypt emptying their gear.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Crack' looks like an adjective for elite soldiers, but it is a joke.
explanation.definitionFit: Kit is gear or equipment, as in a soldier's kit.

clue.text: Ran from second dog that is in road

parts.note: a cur is a mongrel dog

indicators.note: in means the abbreviation for that is goes inside the one for road

parts.note: ie is id est, Latin for that is

explanation.surface: Someone fled from a stray dog that came out into the road.
explanation.definitionFit: To scurry is to hurry along with quick short steps, so to have run.

clue.text: Sian left burst balloons

indicators.note: burst means the letters are blown apart and reassembled

explanation.surface: A woman named Sian left the party balloons popped.
explanation.walkthrough: 'balloons' looks like a plural noun but is a verb: swells.
explanation.definitionFit: To balloon is to swell or blow up, so balloons is a verb synonym.

clue.text: Making prisoners flipping snappy with sound of a bell?

parts.note: cons is slang for convicts, prisoners

indicators.note: flipping means the word for snappy is turned over end to end

parts.note: curt means short and snappy in manner
ting is the light ringing noise a bell makes

explanation.surface: Irritable convicts snapping at each other when the bell goes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flipping' looks like a mild British swear word but is the reversal signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Constructing means building or putting together, the same as making.

clue.text: Rip off page, annoyed

parts.note: irate means angry, annoyed

explanation.surface: Someone angrily tearing a page out.
explanation.definitionFit: To pirate is to copy illegally, which is to rip something off.

clue.text: Risks cutting top off nettles

indicators.note: cutting top off means the first letter is removed from the word for risks

parts.note: dangers are risks

explanation.surface: The hazards of trimming the tops off stinging nettles.
explanation.walkthrough: 'nettles' looks like the plants, but it is a verb: irritates.
explanation.definitionFit: To nettle is to irritate or provoke, so nettles means makes cross.

clue.text: Regret about first in line to be monarch

indicators.note: about means the word for regret goes around the initial letter

parts.note: to rue is to regret

indicators.note: first in picks out the opening letter of line

explanation.surface: Sorrow about the heir who is first in line to the throne.
explanation.definitionFit: A monarch reigns, so to be monarch is to govern as sovereign.

clue.text: Hostility over parking place

parts.note: O is the cricket scorer's abbreviation for an over
P is the road-sign abbreviation for parking
a position is a place or location

explanation.surface: A row breaking out over a parking space.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket an over is a set of six balls, written O on scorecards.
explanation.definitionFit: Opposition means resistance or antagonism, a synonym for hostility.

clue.text: Most of well-known artist's work on stage

indicators.note: most of means the last letter is dropped from the word for well-known

parts.note: open means public, known to all, as in an open secret
RA is a Royal Academician, an artist

explanation.surface: A famous artist's work appearing in a theatre.
explanation.walkthrough: RA stands for Royal Academician, a member of London's Royal Academy of Arts.
explanation.definitionFit: An opera is a dramatic work set to music and performed in a theatre.

clue.text: Release without charge

explanation.surface: Letting a suspect go without pressing charges.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both to liberate and costing nothing.

clue.text: Tree fern damaged after I get in the way

indicators.note: after means the jumbled letters come after the single letter I
damaged means the letters of tree fern are knocked out of order

explanation.surface: Someone apologising for damaging a tree fern by blundering into it.
explanation.definitionFit: To interfere is to meddle or obstruct, which is getting in the way.

clue.text: Fancy deleting fashionable picture!

indicators.note: deleting means the word for fashionable is removed from the word for fancy

parts.note: to fancy is to imagine
in means fashionable, as in the in thing

explanation.surface: A smart picture being removed from a gallery, an exclamation of taste.
explanation.definitionFit: An image is a picture or likeness.

clue.text: Drop protest, we're told

indicators.note: we're told signals that the word for protest is heard, not seen

parts.note: dissent is disagreement or protest

explanation.surface: Being instructed to abandon a protest.
explanation.definitionFit: A descent is a drop or downward slope.

clue.text: Had to leave husband and shift location

indicators.note: to leave means the abbreviation for husband goes out of the word had

parts.note: a shift is a loose straight dress

explanation.surface: A wife who had to leave her husband and move house.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shift' looks like a verb meaning move, but it is the noun, a simple dress.
explanation.definitionFit: An address is where someone lives, a location.
